blocking_findings.detail: Uploaded sources do not prove one common business cutoff: cash/bank is labelled 30/06, operational journal ends 02/07, stock contains receipt dates through 23/07 plus two 23/12 future-date anomalies, item export filename is dated 28/07 and purchase-order export 30/07.
258 customer source rows resolve to 256 exact names; duplicate-name pairs require source-owner disposition rather than automatic merge.

Four purchase-party names are not typed as NCC in the uploaded supplier master. Existing canonical Forge standardization already materializes TIẾN ĐẠT; three remaining source-role mappings still require disposition.
60 distinct journal item codes do not exact-match the 277-code uploaded item export. Canonical standardization/alias evidence must resolve them; no guessed code merge is allowed.

The aluminum workbook contains length/piece evidence for available lots but zero populated SỐ KG TỔNG cells. Canonical Nhôm cây/lá stock authority uses Kg; theoretical kg/m evidence must not be promoted to measured stock quantity.

Business process source describes 23 aluminum sheets plus 2 mesh sheets, while the uploaded aluminum workbook contains 21 total sheets, only 18 of which are inventory sheets; no separate mesh opening-stock source was observed.
Two VIPST700 source rows carry 23/12/2026 receipt dates, later than the 05/08/2026 ingest date, and require source-owner correction/disposition.

Available journal activity contains 515 sales rows and 178 receipt rows, with receipts exceeding sales in the observed period; carry-in receivables therefore exist outside the observed activity window and opening AR cannot be inferred safely.
Purchase activity exists but no complete supplier opening/payment history at one common cutoff is proven by the uploaded set.

45 typed journal rows expose fractional Tổng thanh toán values. Pilot mapping requires integer VND minor-unit semantics, so a source-bound rounding rule must be locked before opening/transaction import.
No named pilot account allowlist or complete employee/user source was observed; exactly one active named Giám đốc account remains required before Pilot-02/Pilot-04 gates.
